_comment: PRs touching these paths pass Mirror review but are HELD for a human /code-review high + manual merge (deep-review hold) instead of auto-merging. Optional + graceful: a missing/malformed file, a non-list `paths`, or `enabled`:false all fall back to the code default in outbox_notifier._DEFAULT_DEEP_REVIEW_PATHS. Tuned by Pulse-Check. Globs are fnmatch'd against `gh pr view --json files` paths. A PR carrying the `deep-review-required` label also holds even if it touches none of these. A critical-path PR that Claude already /code-review high'd carries the `deep-review-passed` label and flows through Mirror to auto-merge normally.
_comment_cross_repo: This list is REPO-AGNOSTIC — globs match a PR's file paths in whichever repo it was opened against. The `scripts/` and `config/` entries below therefore only ever match agent-core, and the RSDPM entries only ever match RSDPM. When onboarding another repo, add ITS critical paths here; nothing scopes this file to one repo, and an unlisted repo has NO durable hold at all (only the manual `deep-review-required` label).
